item.title: First Minister receives a festive welcome at Clogher school visit
item.description: First Minister Michelle O'Neill received a festive welcome from pupils at St. Macartan's Primary School in Clogher.

item.title: Hundreds gather to pray for Derrylin man’s recovery
item.description: Hundreds attended a special Mass on Monday night to pray for the speedy recovery of Derrylin man Dáire McCaffrey, who is currently ill in hospital.

item.title: Meet the SWAH Ward 9 Healthcare Staff caring for patients on Christmas Day
item.description: It is a privilege to work Christmas Day and provide care for our patients who are too ill to be at home with their families.

item.title: David McCann: The SWAH Porter keeping spirits bright on Christmas Day
item.description: This Christmas, The Impartial Reporter is recognising some of the many staff who continue to work throughout the festive period, including hospital porter David McCann at the South West Acute Hospital (SWAH).

item.title: Caring Through Christmas: How the palliative team celebrate with patients
item.description: Healthcare Assistant Noleen McGlinchey, Staff Nurses Kirsty Hannigan and Laurelle Carlin, Sister Thelma Graham, and even Boots the Collie dog, help ensure the ward remains a welcoming and caring environment on Christmas Day.

item.title: Women's Aid remain on call as domestic abuse will not stop for Christmas
item.description: This Christmas, while many families across Fermanagh gather to celebrate, vital support services continue to operate to ensure women and children are safe

item.title: From early dinners to late shifts: Nursing in the community this Christmas
item.description: This Christmas, The Impartial Reporter is highlighting the dedication of healthcare staff who work over the festive period, including Lisa Mullan, Team Leader of the Rapid Response Team in Enniskillen and Omagh.

item.title: How Christmas Day looks for firefighters working in Fermanagh and Tyrone
item.description: This Christmas, The Impartial Reporter is celebrating those who are sacrificing their own Christmas Day to keep everyone else safe. Here, the Northern Ireland Fire and Rescue Service tell us about their day.

item.title: Sadness at death of popular former councillor on Christmas Day
item.description: Tributes have been paid following the death on Christmas Day of a former DUP Clogher Valley councillor,Willis Robinson.

item.title: Sadness at death of beloved father, Andrew Knox on Christmas Day
item.description: The local community has been paying tribute to Andrew Cecil George Knox, who passed away suddenly on Christmas Day at the South West Acute Hospital in Enniskillen.
